beats: Every LinkedIn post carried a raw link in the text — exactly what LinkedIn's algorithm seems to quietly punish.
Facebook was inconsistent too — link, hashtags, source, in no fixed order.
Now the link never touches the post body. A Supabase Edge Function publishes first, then drops it into the first comment.
Facebook now follows one fixed order, showing the plain source domain instead of a raw link.
And if that comment fails, it retries — up to three times.
